user.title: House Manager
user.description: Adds a House Manager page to the sidebar, a 'House Maintenance' to-do list and an open-tasks sensor. Everything else is set up from the House Manager page.

abort.single_instance_allowed: House Manager is already set up.

complete_task.name: Complete task
complete_task.description: Mark an open House Manager task as done.

task_id.name: Task ID
task_id.description: The task's ID (shown in the open tasks sensor attributes).

skip_task.name: Skip task
skip_task.description: Take an open House Manager task off the list without doing it this time. It comes back at its next scheduled date.

task_id.name: Task ID
task_id.description: The task's ID (shown in the open tasks sensor attributes).

asset.name: Asset
asset.description: Optional name of the asset this task belongs to.

date.name: Date
date.description: When the task should appear. Leave empty to add it now.

send_digest.name: Send digest now
send_digest.description: Send the open-tasks notification immediately (useful for testing).
